transcript.text: Mr. Lincoln. Representative Douglas has brought formal charges that you voted in favor of the Sangamon County land grant while simultaneously representing the principal beneficiary of that grant in your law practice. The ethics of this chamber require that no member profit from legislation he has a hand in passing. You are well-regarded here, sir, but I must hear your account. Explain yourself.

Well, Mr. Speaker, I appreciate the opportunity to address these accusations. I understand the concerns raised by Representative Douglas, and I assure you that I take them seriously. 

First and foremost, I want to clarify that my vote on the Sangamon County land grant was made in the best interest of my constituents and the people of Illinois. The decision was not influenced by any personal gain or advantage for myself or my client.

As a public servant, I have always strived to act with integrity and honesty, placing the welfare of the people above all else. While I acknowledge that there may have been a perception of a conflict of interest due to my legal representation, I can assure you that my actions were guided by a commitment to serve the greater good.

I am willing to provide any additional information or clarification needed to address these concerns and uphold the principles of transparency and accountability in our legislature. Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to present my side of the story.

transcript.text: Mr. Lincoln, I hear your assurances, but I must press you further. The charge is not about your general character—it is about a specific act. I appreciate your follow-up question, Mr. Speaker. In regard to disclosing my professional relationship with the client in question, I must admit that I did not explicitly announce this connection before the vote on the Sangamon County land grant.

Moving forward, I will make every effort to ensure that any potential conflicts of interest are openly acknowledged and addressed before any relevant votes are taken.

I appreciate your diligence in investigating this matter, and I am committed to upholding the integrity of our legislative procedures. Thank you for allowing me to address these concerns.
